describe: The image shows a painted sci-fi gun in side view, with a wide grey-teal body, ribbed vents near the front, a top sight rail, a bulbous rear end and a brown grip at lower right. A dark circular opening sits below the body on the left, and a bright white glowing spot is below the grip. The background is speckled pale grey and white. Lighting is soft with moderate contrast, and the colours are grey, teal and muted brown.
